full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“在 DFT 能量/力/应力之外加入跨温度构型、相对自由能、熵或热膨胀信息；用主动学习补采相变、畴壁和相竞争区域，再用热力学积分、MC 或有限温度 MD 验证”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂ 基铁电、二维滑移铁电、钙钛矿和磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。

full_list.abstract: Quantum Zeno dynamics (QZD) and dynamical decoupling (DD) are useful tools that enable the effective suppression of noise in quantum systems. We consider the problem of when (i) noise can be suppressed and (ii) Heisenberg limit (HL) can be achieved in quantum metrology, and prove necessary and sufficient conditions for when QZD and DD are useful for achieving these two goals. We further show this condition can hold even when the Hamiltonian-not-in-Lindblad-span (HNLS) condition fails, allowing QZD/DD to recover Heisenberg scaling beyond what is certified by the usual HNLS-based quantum error correction (QEC) criterion. Finally, we demonstrate that the combination of both techniques can allow individually imperfect QZD and DD strategies to saturate HL.

full_list.abstract: We are continuously sending information to each other, transmitting zeros and ones through a giant network of connected computers and devices. Scientists are now trying to extend this familiar concept of the internet to the quantum realm, looking for an efficient way to exchange quantum rather than classical information: qubits instead of bits. The motivation is not just scientific curiosity. Qubits can be a 0, a 1 or any superposition of the two. They can also become entangled, showing a degree of correlation that is out of reach for classical bits.

full_list.title_en: Optimization and Electrochemical Evaluation of PVA assisted Electrospun Polyindole Nanofibers for Supercapacitors
full_list.title_zh: 用于超级电容器的PVA辅助电纺聚吲哚纳米纤维的优化和电化学评价
full_list.abstract: Conducting polymer nanostructures exhibit good theoretical capacitance but there1D nanostructuring remains a challenge. In this study, polyindole nanofibers were successfully fabricated by electrospinning method using PVA as carrier polymer. For the investigation of its chemical, structural and morphological properties, XRD, FTIR and FESEM techniques were used. The electrochemical performance was evaluated by CV and GCD assessment in 3 M KOH electrolyte. XRD results confirmed the amorphous nature of polyindole whereas characteristic functional groups and vibrational modes were identified by FTIR. FESEM images revealed non-woven, bead free uniform nanofibers with average diameter ranging between 200–300 nm. Among the three electrodes, P2 exhibited highest specific capacitance of 387 F/g at scan rate of 5 mV/s and 356.7 F/g at 0.5 A/g from CV and GCD profiles respectively. Areal capacitance exhibited by P2 was found to be 1161 mF/ cm⁻² at 5 mV/s. Electrochemical study shows overall pseudocapacitive behavior of all three samples with significant super capacitance retained at higher scan rates and increased current densities, indicating good rate capability. Overall, these findings demonstrate the potential of as such fabricated electrospun polyindole nanofibers as a promising electrode material for supercapacitor applications.

full_list.title_en: Seasonal Variability of Soil Radon Exhalation Under Climate Forcing: An Example of Humid Subtropical Highland Climate
full_list.title_zh: 气候强迫下土壤氡析出的季节变化：湿润亚热带高原气候的一个例子
full_list.abstract: Radon (²²²Rn) migrates from soil to the atmosphere by molecular diffusion and pressure-driven advection while decaying with a 3.82-day half-life. Surface exhalation varies seasonally because the two governing soil properties, the effective diffusion coefficient and the radon source strength, both depend on soil moisture and temperature. Existing one-dimensional models are typically solved at steady state or with static properties, and few openly available tools ingest meteorological forcing to resolve the flux as a time-evolving signal. We present a model that solves the full transient diffusion–advection–decay equation in a layered 1-D soil column (0–200 cm) using an implicit Crank–Nicolson scheme. The effective diffusion coefficient follows the Rogers–Nielson moisture relation with a gas-kinetic temperature correction; pore air–water partitioning uses the temperature-dependent Ostwald coefficient; emanation responds to moisture and temperature; and a damped analytical thermal wave plus a leaky-bucket moisture model translate monthly climate inputs into depth- and time-resolved forcing. The solver matches the exact analytical steady state to a root-mean-square error of 0.0003%. Under idealized seasonal forcing representative of a humid subtropical highland (Murree-type) climate, the modelled flux is strongly bimodal: a pre-monsoon June maximum from warm, drying soil, a pronounced July–August monsoon minimum where high saturation collapses diffusivity and traps radon at depth, and an autumn recovery. The annual mean is ~ 245 Bq m⁻² h⁻¹ with a peak-to-peak range near 40%. Sensitivity analysis shows near-linear scaling with radium activity, emanation and bulk density, and nonlinear response to porosity and moisture. A factorial attribution experiment shows the two controls act nearly additively, moisture contributing a larger variance share (≈ 60%) than temperature (≈ 40%); moisture alone reproduces the bimodal shape, temperature alone a single summer maximum. This competition between moisture-enhanced emanation and moisture-suppressed diffusion reconciles the apparent paradox that wetting raises soil-air radon yet can reduce exhalation, providing a reproducible, climate-forced framework for interpreting exhalation time series and generating hypotheses about climate-driven change.
full_list.abstract_zh: 氡气 (²²²Rn) 通过分子扩散和压力驱动的平流从土壤迁移到大气中，同时衰变，半衰期为 3.82 天。地表呼气随季节变化，因为有效扩散系数和氡源强度这两个控制土壤特性都取决于土壤湿度和温度。现有的一维模型通常在稳态或静态属性下求解，并且很少有公开可用的工具吸收气象强迫来将通量解析为随时间演化的信号。我们提出了一个模型，该模型使用隐式克兰克-尼科尔森方案求解分层一维土柱（0-200 cm）中的完整瞬态扩散-平流-衰变方程。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 氡气 (²²²Rn) 通过分子扩散和压力驱动的平流从土壤迁移到大气中，同时衰变，半衰期为 3.82 天。地表呼气随季节变化，因为有效扩散系数和氡源强度这两个控制土壤特性都取决于土壤湿度和温度。现有的一维模型通常在稳态或静态属性下求解，并且很少有公开可用的工具吸收气象强迫来将通量解析为随时间演化的信号。我们提出了一个模型，该模型使用隐式克兰克-尼科尔森方案求解分层一维土柱（0-200 cm）中的完整瞬态扩散-平流-衰变方程。有效扩散系数遵循带有气体动力学温度校正的罗杰斯-尼尔森湿度关系；孔隙空气-水分配使用与温度相关的奥斯特瓦尔德系数；散发对湿度和温度有反应；阻尼分析热波加上漏桶湿度模型将每月的气候输入转化为深度和时间分辨的强迫。求解器将精确的分析稳态与 0.0003% 的均方根误差相匹配。在代表湿润亚热带高原（穆里型）气候的理想化季节性强迫下，模拟的通量具有强烈的双峰性：季风前六月的最大值来自温暖、干燥的土壤，明显的七月至八月季风最小值，其中高饱和度破坏扩散性并在深处捕获氡气，以及秋季恢复。年均值约为 245 Bq m⁻² h⁻1，峰峰值范围接近 40%。灵敏度分析显示，镭活度、散发量和堆积密度呈近线性比例，而孔隙度和湿度呈非线性响应。因子归因实验表明，两个控制几乎相加，湿度贡献的方差份额 (≈ 60%) 比温度 (≈ 40%) 更大；单独的湿度再现双峰形状，单独的温度再现单个夏季最大值。水分增强的散发和水分抑制的扩散之间的竞争调和了明显的悖论，即湿润会增加土壤-空气氡气，但会减少呼气，为解释呼气时间序列和生成有关气候驱动的变化的假设提供了一个可重复的、气候强制的框架。

full_list.title_en: Enhancing energy resilience and efficiency in port energy systems: An integrated framework for resilience assessment
full_list.title_zh: 增强港口能源系统的能源弹性和效率：弹性评估综合框架
full_list.abstract: Maritime ports are increasingly conceptualized as energy hubs, i.e., interfaces between diverse energy infrastructures capable of producing, converting, storing, and consuming energy. However, this transformation merges two critical infrastructures, maritime transportation and energy systems, thereby amplifying exposure to systemic shocks and cross-system disruptions. Strengthening the energy resilience and efficiency of port energy systems is therefore essential. This study defines and validates a comprehensive set of resilience indicators for assessing energy systems in general and port energy systems in particular, making two primary contributions: First, it conceptualizes an Energy Resilience Matrix that organizes 77 resilience indicators across four system layers — Infrastructure, Information, Governance, and Community — and four resilience functions: Plan/Prepare, Absorb, Recover, and Adapt. Second, it incorporates port authority perspectives to evaluate the practical relevance of these indicators for port energy systems. Empirical findings support the strategic utility of both the indicators and the Energy Resilience Matrix as tools for building energy resilience capacity and efficiency. Nevertheless, the research also offers a critical reflection on indicator-based approaches to resilience measurement. Respondents identified challenges in operationalizing certain indicators due to financial and technological constraints. Moreover, an overreliance on quantitative metrics risks producing a technocentric perspective that marginalizes the governance structures and stakeholder communities integral to systemic resilience. These limitations point to the need for future research exploring alternative frameworks better suited to capturing the multidimensional character of energy resilience, alongside the development of financial incentives and robust business cases to ensure the long-term economic viability of resilience interventions.
full_list.abstract_zh: 海港越来越多地被概念化为能源中心，即能够生产、转换、储存和消耗能源的不同能源基础设施之间的接口。然而，这种转型融合了海运和能源系统这两个关键基础设施，从而放大了系统性冲击和跨系统破坏的风险。因此，加强港口能源系统的能源弹性和效率至关重要。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 海港越来越多地被概念化为能源中心，即能够生产、转换、储存和消耗能源的不同能源基础设施之间的接口。然而，这种转型融合了海运和能源系统这两个关键基础设施，从而放大了系统性冲击和跨系统破坏的风险。因此，加强港口能源系统的能源弹性和效率至关重要。本研究定义并验证了一套全面的弹性指标，用于评估一般能源系统，特别是港口能源系统，做出了两个主要贡献：首先，它概念化了一个能源弹性矩阵，该矩阵组织了四个系统层（基础设施、信息、治理和社区）的 77 个弹性指标以及四个弹性功能：计划/准备、吸收、恢复和适应。其次，它结合了港务局的观点来评估这些指标对港口能源系统的实际相关性。实证结果支持指标和能源弹性矩阵作为建设能源弹性能力和效率的工具的战略效用。尽管如此，该研究也对基于指标的复原力测量方法进行了批判性反思。受访者指出，由于财务和技术限制，在实施某些指标方面存在挑战。此外，过度依赖定量指标可能会产生以技术为中心的观点，从而使治理结构和利益相关者社区边缘化，而这些是系统弹性的组成部分。这些局限性表明，未来的研究需要探索更适合捕捉能源弹性的多维特征的替代框架，同时制定财政激励措施和强有力的商业案例，以确保弹性干预措施的长期经济可行性。

full_list.title_zh: 水稻 OsMOT 基因家族的全基因组鉴定、非生物胁迫反应和单倍型变异
full_list.abstract: Background Molybdenum (Mo) is an essential trace element for plants, playing critical roles in nitrogen metabolism, hormone biosynthesis, and stress responses. Molybdate transporters (MOTs) mediate molybdate uptake, translocation, and distribution, and are essential for maintaining cellular molybdenum homeostasis. To date, the functional differentiation, abiotic stress response patterns, and genome-wide allelic variation landscape of the MOT family across global rice (Oryza sativa) germplasm collections remain poorly understood.Results Through homologous sequence alignment and conserved domain verification, we identified four MOT genes in the Oryza sativa genome, clustered into two subfamilies, MOT1 and MOT2. All members harbor a transmembrane domain of the major facilitator superfamily (MFS). Phylogenetic, gene structure, and protein 3D structure prediction analyses revealed segmental duplication as the primary driver of family expansion, with the family evolving under dominant purifying selection. The two subfamilies exhibit pronounced divergence in channel geometry and substrate recognition: MOT1 uses a cooperative hydrogen bond-salt bridge network, while MOT2 forms a hydrogen bond interface with few polar residues. Protein-protein interaction network prediction linked the MOT family to the molybdopterin biosynthesis pathway. Tissue expression profiling and abiotic stress qRT-PCR assays revealed spatiotemporal functional divergence between the two subfamilies: OsMOT1;2 responded rapidly and specifically to salt stress, while OsMOT2;1 responded broadly to multiple abiotic stresses. Haplotype analysis of global rice germplasm whole-genome resequencing data further showed the highest MOT family diversity in the Southeast Asia-South China rice domestication center, with clear indica-japonica differentiation and reduced diversity after transcontinental introduction.Conclusions This study provides insights into the functional differentiation of the rice MOT family from evolutionary, structural, transcriptional, and population genetic perspectives, characterizes the predicted structural features and stress response patterns of the MOT2 subfamily, and uncovers the haplotype distribution and domestication trajectory of MOT genes across global rice germplasms. These findings provide a theoretical basis and candidate genes for improving molybdenum use efficiency and stress tolerance in rice breeding.

full_list.abstract: The valorization of industrial ceramic waste into functional separation materials offers a promising route toward reducing membrane fabrication costs while mitigating solid-waste disposal. This study developed a low-cost ceramic membrane using ceramic dust and wall ceramic sludge as the sole inorganic raw materials, followed by surface functionalization with polyamide 6 (PA6) and Fe2O3 to treat the arsenic-contaminated water. The waste-derived membrane was prepared using a 3:1 sludge-to-dust ratio and sintered at 1100°C for 1.75 h. The resulting membrane exhibited 19.15 MPa flexural strength and a permeability of 103.75 L/m2.h. Surface modification decreased the overall porosity from 39.7% to 35.5% and reduced the median pore diameter from 0.615 to 0.420 µm, confirming pore-coating and partial pore narrowing. SEM-EDX and FTIR analyses verified the incorporation of Fe2O3 and PA6 onto the membrane surface. The modified membrane exhibited a zeta potential of 6.84 and achieved As(V) rejection of 84% with a flux of 394.25 L/m2.h at an initial concentration of 1ppm. full_list.title_en: A Probabilistic Dual-Track Framework for Least-Cost Electrification in Sub-Saharan Africa
full_list.title_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲最低成本电气化的概率双轨框架
full_list.abstract: Sub-Saharan Africa retains the world's largest electricity access deficit. This study develops a Dual-Track Energy Architecture (DTEA) that routes decentralised renewable supply to dispersed households while concentrating grid investment on industrial and high-load demand, using a lifetime net-present-value model with country-specific discount rates (9–15% WACC), post-connection demand growth (2–7%/yr), and reliability-adjusted supply costs, with parameter uncertainty propagated through a Monte Carlo simulation (M = 20,000 draws per country, 8 correlated parameters) across five countries. Median break-even distances span more than an order of magnitude: 0.0 km in the DRC (P5–P95: 0.0–2.4), 1.1 km in Nigeria (0.0–10.4), 8.1 km in Ghana (2.0–20.2), 8.6 km in Cameroon (1.7–22.1), and 15.3 km in Namibia (5.7–35.1). Reliability adjustment is decisive: a naive tariff-based lifetime model overstates the Nigerian threshold by roughly 25× (27.8 km vs. 1.1 km) and the DRC threshold by more than 10× (11.6 km vs. 0.0 km). Spearman sensitivity analysis shows grid availability and grid cost dominate in weak-grid countries, while line cost and connection density dominate in Namibia, where reliable grids hold. Adding a 1,500 kWh/yr productive-use load extends Namibia's break-even distance from 15.3 km to 45.0 km but leaves the DRC's at 0.0 km, confirming that anchor loads strengthen the case for grid investment only where grid reliability already supports it. Applying the resulting probabilistic zoning to 2,500 settlements samples (CIESIN GHSL/MSPHP, OpenStreetMap grid distances, Meta Relative Wealth Index) under an identical rule in every country, with distance measured against a single voltage class, classifies 33.0% of Namibian settlements as grid-priority versus 98.0% of DRC settlements and 71.4–77.2% of Nigerian and Cameroonian settlements as decentralised-only, and relative wealth declines significantly with distance from the mapped network in each of the five countries tested separately. These results are derived from literature-sourced parameters and are presented as a framework demonstration rather than calibrated country forecasts.

full_list.abstract: Outdoor terahertz (THz) communication links suffer severe, time-varying degradation from rain and atmospheric attenuation, yet most prior work including our earlier study evaluates this impairment at fixed, discrete rain rates rather than forecasting it as a dynamic process. This paper proposes a real-weather driven THz channel and Link Quality Index (LQI) forecasting framework: a composite, application-relevant metric combining channel, reliability, and hard ware margins, computed by a physics-based simulator (ITU-R P.838-3 rain attenuation, ITU-R P.676 gaseous attenuation, and a modified Friis link bud get) driven by six years of hourly meteorological observations (51,888 records) from Sylhet , Bangladesh. We benchmark seven forecasting models and these are persistence, linear regression, random forest, XGBoost, GRU, LSTM, and a Transformer across four forecast horizons (1, 3, 6, and 12 hours) under a leak-free chronological 70/15/15 split, with hyperparameter sensitivity, multi-seed robust ness, Diebold–Mariano significance testing, Monte Carlo Dropout uncertainty calibration, SHAP explainability, a feature-group ablation, and a degradation conditioned stratified evaluation. Results show forecast skill of 21.5%–31.4% over persistence, well-calibrated but progressively overconfident uncertainty at longer horizons, and substantially higher error during rain and low-LQI conditions. To further validate the framework, we apply the identical pipeline to a second, climatically contrasting site (Rajshahi, Bangladesh) and find that the centralting site (Rajshahi, Bangladesh) and find that the central conclusions, including that aggregate metrics hide severe forecast failures under degraded conditions, hold consistently across both sites.

full_list.title_en: Explainable artificial intelligence in interface design influences user outcomes and cybersecurity literacy
full_list.title_zh: 界面设计中的可解释人工智能会影响用户结果和网络安全素养
full_list.abstract: Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) exposes information that users can examine when assessing AI-generated recommendations. However, limited evidence is available on whether explanation-supported interaction develops competencies relevant to privacy and cybersecurity literacy. This study examined whether an XAI-enhanced design tool affects creative confidence, perceived learning, reported trust, perceived autonomy, and usability during a UI design task. We conducted a controlled between-groups experiment with 128 participants. Participants were randomly assigned to an XAI condition (n = 64) or a standard AI condition (n = 64). Both groups completed the same UI design task. The XAI tool presented rationales and trade-offs with each suggestion, whereas the standard tool presented suggestions alone. Results show that the XAI condition produced a larger creative-confidence gain (d = 0.68). Post-task perceived learning (d = 1.17) reported trust (d = 0.97), and perceived autonomy (d = 0.42; all p<.05) were also higher. Usability was higher under XAI (d = 1.78). Logged interaction counts were higher in XAI condition (d = 2.66). Across the full sample, these counts correlated with perceived learning, reported trust, usability, and task quality (all r≥.35). Thus, XAI was associated with stronger self-reported outcomes and higher usability during AI-assisted design. The findings support explanations as an interface feature that may promote critical engagement with AI recommendations. However, trust calibration, privacy literacy, dark-pattern recognition, and resistance to deceptive interfaces were not measured directly. The results indicate potential relevance to privacy and cybersecurity literacy, not demonstrated behavioural resilience. Direct transfer should be evaluated using realistic privacy-decision tasks.
